text:
I'm sorry your plant arrived damaged. A snapped main stem counts as damage on arrival, but that needs to be reported within 48 hours of delivery, and at 3 days you're past that window. After 48 hours, plant issues go through the Plant Care Guarantee instead.

You can file a claim from "My Orders" within 30 days of delivery (90 days for Leafy Plus members) with at least two photos, one of the whole plant and one close-up. A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. The guarantee covers a plant that dies or declines significantly, and the excerpts I have don't say whether a stem snapped in transit qualifies on its own, so I can't promise a replacement. If you'd like, I can escalate this to a Support Lead to look at the timing.
